bifrost: springboard/src/shell/weather/data.rs (Open-Meteo forecast fetch and parsing), springboard/apps/weather-desktop/src/weather.rs (Weather app); no app-facing weather API in springboard/sdk/src/
summary: BifrOSt has a working forecast pipeline for the Weather app: current conditions, hourly and 10-day daily forecasts, UV, sunrise and sunset, fed by Open-Meteo rather than WeatherKit. There is no SDK weather service for other apps, and alerts, minute forecasts, moon data, historical statistics and attribution have no counterpart.

features.note: The forecast request, the per-place cache and the offline read are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-21.rs, and a failed air-quality host does not fail the forecast. Gap: the code lives in the Weather app's data module, no SDK type exposes a weather request, and the data source is not the reference service.

Temperature, apparent temperature, humidity, wind, condition code and day flag are parsed from the current block, and the WMO code to Sky mapping is tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-21.rs. Gap: the condition text is the local Sky label, not the service's.

Speed, direction in degrees and gusts are requested and parsed; the direction wraps into one turn and a missing reading is calm, tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-21.rs. Gap: no compass label and no beaufort scale.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 2 (theme-37, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Precipitation kind comes only from the weather code. No amounts, probabilities or snowfall are requested.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 8 tests. Wave 3 (theme-15, parity/integration cf8e852d): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The forecast URL does not request pressure.
The daily peak is read from uv_index_max, and a day without it reads as zero; tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-21.rs. Gap: no current or hourly UV index.
The 24 hours from the current hour and 10 days are built with rain, snow, visibility and pressure, tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-21.rs. Gap: no day-part forecasts.

verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 7 tests. Wave 2 (theme-37, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No minute-level precipitation request or type.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/weather_alert.rs; wired: springboard/apps/weather-desktop/src/insights.rs (footer_lines alert availability via WeatherAvailability; alert_banner via most_severe, not drawn)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 2 (theme-37, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. The forecast URL requests no alert data, and no code in the repo models alerts. The notification layer (springboard/src/shell/usernotif.rs) has no weather source. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

Each day's sunrise and sunset clock times, and the sunrise or sunset that falls in an hour, are tested headless in springboard/tests/parity_sdk-tests-21.rs. SunEvents (astronomical, nautical and civil dawn and dusk, sunrise, sunset, solar noon and midnight; None in polar day or night), MoonPhase (eight cases with symbol names) and MoonEvents (phase, moonrise, moonset) are a pure offline model in sun_moon.rs, host-tested by reykjavik_midsummer_has_the_published_sunrise_and_sunset_and_no_astronomical_dusk, reykjavik_midwinter_has_a_short_day, the_equator_at_an_equinox_has_a_day_of_about_twelve_hours, above_the_arctic_circle_the_midsummer_sun_does_not_set, the_moon_phase_matches_published_2026_new_and_full_moons and a_full_moon_rises_near_sunset_and_sets_near_sunrise. Field names follow the public WeatherKit documentation: the WeatherKit binary sits in the macOS 27 dyld cache, which is not unpacked, so no binary evidence id exists. Gap: the model is not wired into the Weather app; the moon is a mean synodic model (phase within hours, rise and set within about an hour), not an ephemeris.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/weather_model.rs (WeatherError::from_io, is_retryable); springboard/src/shell/weather/data.rs (fetch_forecast returns io::Error); springboard/apps/weather-desktop/src/weather.rs; tests: springboard/ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-26.rs
features.note: A typed WeatherError maps permission refusals, network failures and unreadable answers to their own kinds, each with its own message and retry rule, and is tested headless. Gap: the weather service's own error codes are not parsed, so a server-side refusal still reads as an unreachable service or an unknown error; the mapping needs a live check on Midget.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/weather_attribution.rs; wired: springboard/apps/weather-desktop/src/insights.rs (footer_lines, WeatherAttribution); springboard/apps/weather-desktop/src/weather.rs (footer loop after the MAP card)
features.note: verified on Midget 0.7.25 by 5 tests. Wave 2 (theme-37, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No attribution text for Open-Meteo was found in springboard/apps/weather-desktop/src or springboard/src/shell/weather. Apple requires attribution with WeatherKit data, so an equivalent is needed for any provider shown in the UI. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

gaps: No app-facing weather SDK API in springboard/sdk/src/. Other apps cannot request weather without copying the Open-Meteo code.
No weather alerts (WeatherAlert, severity, availability) from any data source.
No historical or statistical weather data (daily and monthly statistics, trends, historical comparisons, percentiles, weather changes).
Sun and moon events are not wired into the Weather app, and the moon is a mean-month model rather than an ephemeris.
No pressure trend, wind direction or gust, or precipitation amounts and probabilities.
No typed WeatherError enum, and no attribution text for the data provider.
Data is Open-Meteo, not WeatherKit. Apple's coverage of data sources and quality does not carry over.
